evidence_excerpts: R.B.’s recollections provide an existence proof for a kind of memory that navigates between the horns of Schechtman’s dilemma. In R.B., the ‘mineness’ of episodic recollection is separated from the content.
text: R.B.'s unowned recollections provide an existence proof for apparent memory content that is neither delusional nor identity-presupposing.
